{{Quote|I'm no techhunter, so when I look at the doubler suit I see everything that's gone wrong with our proud art.|[[Chentu Chek]]|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
A '''Holographic Projector Doubler Suit''', commonly referred to as simply '''doubler suit''', was hardware capable projecting a duplicate image of the wearer in the hopes of drawing enemy fire away from the owner.

==Description==
A doubler suit used a holovid recorder and projector to copy the user's image and beam a doppelganger somewhere else in the hopes of drawing enemy fire.
